column1: # Live thread dump from an Ignition 8.1.11 gateway.
# Captured: 2026-07-31, via 'kill -3' on the gateway JVM (see docs/development.md)
# 117 threads. This is exactly the set ThreadMXBean.getAllThreadIds() reports:
# the dump also contained 13 VM-internal threads (GC Thread#N, G1 *, VM Thread,
# VM Periodic Task Thread) which carry no java.lang.Thread.State line and are
# NOT visible to ThreadMXBean. They are deliberately absent from this fixture.
